subject: Mutual plan sync: weekly cadence, owners, and acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@hawthorne.com>; Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@hawthorne.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@hawthorne.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan sync: weekly cadence, owners, and acceptance criteria

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks for the productive demo last week. As discussed, I put together a draft mutual plan (attached) that lays out the evaluation timeline, checkpoints, and success criteria so we can close predictably. High-level ask: confirm stakeholders, agree a weekly checkpoint cadence, and validate the acceptance criteria so the evaluation team can start tests next week.

Proposed cadence: 30-minute weekly checkpoints (Tuesdays) during the evaluation window (4 weeks). First checkpoint suggested: Tue Aug 4, 10:00am PT.

Key success criteria (draft):
- End-to-end integration with Hawthorne staging by end of week 2
- Latency < 220ms p50 on representative prompts
- Average token cost within target range (we'll present batching/quantization options)
- No unresolved security blockers in SOC2 checklist

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP timeline + owners), Evaluation_Timeline_v1.xlsx (detailed weekly tasks).

Can you confirm:
1) Primary technical contact for integration (owner for integration tasks)
2) Procurement/contract owner for NDAs/POs
3) If Tuesdays 10am PT work for the weekly checkpoints

I'll loop in our solutions engineer and CS lead once we have names.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@hawthorne.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan sync: weekly cadence, owners, and acceptance criteria

Thanks Rachel — this looks good and aligns with our internal timeline. Confirming stakeholders:
- Emily Rogers (Evaluation lead) — I will coordinate test plans and acceptance verification
- Tom Nguyen (Platform lead) — will own integration work and staging access
- Procurement Team (procurement@hawthorne.com) — will handle NDA and contract routing

Tuesdays 10:00am PT work for us. Can you / your team own the agenda for the first two checkpoints? For acceptance criteria, two quick clarifications:
1) When you say "end-to-end integration by week 2" do you mean sample traffic + KV cache tests or full staging traffic? We prefer sample traffic first.
2) We'll need a short list of representative prompts and success thresholds for the QA team — can your solutions engineer propose that before the first checkpoint?

I'll get Procurement to review the NDA (Tom will forward internal contact).

-Emily
Emily Rogers
Director, Product Operations
Hawthorne Analytics

Subject: Re: Mutual plan sync: weekly cadence, owners, and acceptance criteria

Emily / Rachel — looping in details from the Redwood side so owners are clear.

Internal owners (Redwood):
- Sergio Alvarez (Solutions Engineering) — technical integration, prompt set, representative traffic, and baseline perf tests
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — MAP cadence owner, onboarding checklist, runbook for troubleshooting and service escalations

Rachel: attached SOC2-questions-answers.docx with initial responses to the security checklist Emily mentioned; it covers data flow, retention, and key management notes. We'll follow up with the SOC2 artifact dump if Procurement requests it.

Agenda I propose for the first 30-minute checkpoint (Aug 4):
- 5m quick intros + roles
- 10m integration state & blockers (Tom + Sergio)
- 10m QA prompts & success thresholds (Sergio + Emily)
- 5m next steps / owners / deliverables

Sergio action items:
- Share a small canonical prompt set for Hawthorne QA by Mon Aug 2 EOD (owner: sergio.alvarez)
- Provide instructions for generating test keys + sample cURL for staging by Mon Aug 2 (owner: sergio.alvarez)

Marissa action items:
- Send calendar invite for weekly Tuesdays 10am PT (owner: marissa.cole)
- Prepare map status template for checkpoints (owner: marissa.cole)

Happy to adjust agenda — small, focused first call will help the team ramp quickly.

Thanks,

Great — thanks all for the fast alignment. Confirming the plan and next steps before the first weekly checkpoint on Tue Aug 4 at 10:00am PT (Google Meet link below).

Confirmed cadence: Weekly checkpoints, Tuesdays 10:00am PT (30 min). First meeting: Tue Aug 4, 10:00am PT (recurring for 4 weeks).

Consolidated action items and owners (due dates):

- Sergio: Deliver canonical prompt set + staging cURL and test key instructions by Mon Aug 2 EOD (owner: Sergio Alvarez)
- Marissa: Send calendar invite + MAP status template by Mon Aug 2 (owner: Marissa Cole)
